title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About SANOVIO SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily. Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use. When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care. About the Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer , you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers . You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems , untangle their data and processes , and ship the solutions that make them successful. This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics , or bring experience in technical product management , product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense : what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees. Tasks Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers Owning customer implementations end to end , from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders Communication and customer focus You enjoy talking to customers : you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland General Profile Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much Strong process understanding : you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience . Internships and working student jobs count too Technical skillset First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills Product and design affinity : you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus Bonus if you Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP , integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too) Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped Benefits A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners Monthly wellness budget Access to the AI and productivity tools you need Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares About the interview process Step 1: Intro call Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience. Step 2: Case study A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer. Step 3: Personal fit Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style. Step 4: Offer & reference checks If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references. title: Working Student, Launch Vehicle Structures (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief

As a Working Student in the Loads & Dynamics team, you will be at the heart of launch vehicle development. Every structural component, subsystem, and design decision ultimately depends on one fundamental question: what environments and loads will the vehicle experience during flight? 

Our team provides the engineering foundation that answers this question. By combining expertise in structural loads, dynamics, aerodynamics, thermal analysis, and fluid dynamics, we predict and characterize the complex physical environments encountered throughout all phases of flight. 

You will work directly with experienced engineers on real development activities, flight data analysis, and engineering methods used to support current and future launch vehicle programs. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with aerospace engineering challenges while contributing to safe, reliable, and independent access to space. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Flight & Test Data Analysis 
    • Support the verification and validation of loads and dynamics methodologies 
    • Develop tools and scripts for efficient data processing and comparison 
    • Compare analytical and numerical predictions against test and flight results 
    • Identify opportunities to improve models, processes, and engineering methods 
  • Post-Processing & Visualization 
    • Develop and improve automated workflows for simulation and test data evaluation 
    • Generate flow visualizations, section views, and engineering-relevant data extracts 
  • Sensors & Instrumentation 
    • Support sensor-related activities, including documentation and configuration management 
    • Perform trade studies and evaluate instrumentation solutions for flight and test campaigns 
  • Multidisciplinary Engineering Support 
    • Contribute to a broad range of Loads & Dynamics activities across the vehicle development lifecycle 
    • Gain exposure to structural loads, structural dynamics, aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, and thermal analysis 

 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g. Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Physics or similar)  
  • Interest in data analysis, simulation, and physical systems 
  • Programming experience with Python or Matlab 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with professional proficiency in English. 
  • Located in or near Munich, as the role requires regular on-site presence 

Bonus Skills

  • Basic knowledge of structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, or aerospace engineering 
  • Experience with CFD postprocessing tools such as ParaView, Tecplot, StarCCM+, Ansys 
  • Experience with GitLab 

 

Benefits

  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket or a fuel allowance
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Free snacks and drinks: Indulge in a variety of free snacks and beverages to keep you fuelled throughout the day
  • Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team. 

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!
